It is possible to have limited university admission at times. The option of having limited admission depends on the system in which the university operates. There are different types of admission systems for universities, including open admission, selective admission based on a test, or must-attend application and admission. Most of these admission systems can be designed with limited admission options for specific courses or programs. The ability to impose limited undergraduate admission on universities in India or elsewhere can be a theoretical situation only. Consequently, the limitation is dependent on the university-specific policies and the approach undergone by the institution. These policies would vary on specific conditions. Implementing a limited admission option on universities in India would depend very much on the system utilized by the institution.
